buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Supply Requirement: - 01 No. Tractor along with 01 No. Trolley. - Tractor and Trolley must be supplied as a complete package. 3. Mandatory Documents: GST Registration Certificate. PAN Card. Aadhaar Card. ATC Acceptance Declaration. Non-Blacklisted Declaration. must be submitted on a ₹300 Notarized Stamp Paper. Non-Bankrupt Declaration. E-Mandate Form duly signed by the Bank and Bidder. 4. Eligibility Criteria: Bidder must be registered in Gujarat. Bidder must have at least 01 existing Service Station in Sabarkantha & Aravalli District.

Service Station must have been operational for a minimum of the last 3 years. Supporting proof must be at tached. Bidder must not have been punished by any Honourable Court for criminal activity. 5. Financial Requirements: CA-certified Annual Turnover Certificate for the last 3 years. OEM Annual Turnover details. OEM Turnover 20.00 lakhs must needed. Bidder Turnover 10.00 lakhs must needed. 6. OEM Documents: OEM Authorization Letter. OEM Annual Turnover Certificate. 7. ISO Certificate: Bidder must upload its own firm's ISO 9001:2015 Certificate. 8. Other Important Conditions: Conditional bids will not be accepted. Any complaint regarding the technical bid will not be entertained after the opening of financial bids. Important: The bidder must arrange all the above documents, fulfill the eligibility criteria, and submit the E MD of ₹15,000 before participating in the tender. .
